events.title: Once Caldas ( Colombia ) defeats 보카 주니어스 ( Argentina ) 1–1 on aggregate, 2–0 on penalties to win the Copa Libertadores .
첼시 pay £13.2 million for FC 포르투 's 파울루 페헤이라 and £12 million for PSV 에인트호번 's 아르연 로번 . 리버풀 buy 지브릴 시세 from 오세르 for £14 million.
Greece win the UEFA Euro 2004 football tournament, defeating the host nation Portugal in a 1–0 upset victory.

The Sun newspaper issues an apology to 리버풀 fans over its infamous front-page story about the Hillsborough disaster 15 years ago, but the apology is not welcomed by many of the club's supporters; a poll on the club's official website shows an 87% disapproval rate of the newspaper's apology.
미들즈브러 sign 리즈 유나이티드 striker Mark Viduka for £4.5 million.
첼시 sign Serbian striker Mateja Kežman from PSV 에인트호번 for £5 million.
첼시 pay a club record £24 million for Ivorian striker 디디에 드로그바 from 마르세유 and also sign midfielder Tiago from 벤피카 for £8 million.
Brazil win the Copa América football tournament, defeating Argentina 4–2 on penalties.
Gerard van der Lem is fired as manager of the Saudi Arabia national football team .
첼시 sign FC 포르투 defender 히카르두 카르발류 for £19.85 million.
Nicky Butt leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드, where he has spent his whole career, and joins 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for £2.5 million.
웨스트브로미치 앨비언 sign Hungarian midfielder 졸탄 게라 from 페렌츠바로시 for £1.5 million.

The Olympic Stadium in Berlin is given a new lease of life after a four-year renovation. The stadium is to stage the Football World Cup 2006 final, Germany's biggest sporting spectacle since reunification, exactly 70 years after the infamous Nazi Olympics . (BBC)
